copy.headline: Arlington police searching for Daryine JONES, wanted for injury to a child
copy.caption:
Arlington police are looking for Daryine JONES, wanted for injury to a child. Crime Stoppers is offering up to $2,000 for information leading to an arrest.

Call 817-469-TIPS (8477) or submit a tip at 469tips.com. You stay anonymous.
